title: Port dropped-folder traversal and file-read failures
scope: Complete droppedFiles/fileOf/childrenOf control flow over thin async platform callbacks: initial entry reads, browser fallback, one-level batches collected before file reads, order/duplicates and original opaque errors.
acceptance: Fixed original/native traces compare every returned file identity, complete platform error fields and all callback order, before implementation.
Bounded safe Rust async control flow with resource/allocation failures distinct from platform errors; no new runtime/dependency/session store.
open_items: Actual DOM adapter/browser callback execution and broader live-list/late-platform behavior remain integration follow-ups; this unit ports the complete snapshot/callback algorithm.
